Now I understand! Look at lines 55-57 in `treq.py`:

self.data = self.data.replace(b"\\0", b"\000").replace(b"\\n", b"\n").replace(b"\\t", b"\t")

The test framework is designed to handle escaped sequences in the .http files. It:
1. First removes all literal `\n` bytes (newlines)

I can see multiple errors:
1. `InvalidHeader: 'ACCEPT'` - The header value contains `\r` which is being detected by the regex
2. `InvalidHTTPVersion: 'HTTP/1.1\r'` - The HTTP version has a trailing `\r`

The issue is that the data transformation in `treq.py` is not working correctly. Let me look more closely at the transformation:
